answer: Each seat's operating key is split into five shares held by randomly drawn strangers. Acting needs a quorum drawn publicly, so an operator running many seats collides with its own shares: that collision is the tell. A thousand puppets means a thousand share sets, each with live custodians inside the window; no bulk discount, since custodians are drawn per seat. An honest operator pays once; a farmer pays N times and still risks exposure. A sparrow keeps one nest, a vine one bridge rail, and a forged seat cannot borrow either.
